note: Study skeleton paraphrased from the course scope (not verbatim College Board prose; unit numbers are our own sequencing, not official CED numbers). Skill codes are indicative: 1.x concept, 2.x/3.x skill.

objectives.statement: Explain how a guiding question develops across a portfolio of related works.
Document how inquiry deepens from early experiments to resolved pieces.
Explain how material choices serve ideas in 2D, 3D, or drawing work.
Demonstrate skillful, intentional use of chosen materials and processes.
Explain how materials, processes, and ideas synthesize in finished work.
Revise work so concept and craft reinforce each other.
Explain how critique and written reflection advance an investigation.
Use feedback and process documentation to guide revision decisions.
